name: Callan Periodic Table of Investment Returns
description: An annual chart, published by the institutional investment consultant Callan since 1999, ranking major asset-class index returns from best to worst for each of the last 20 years — the best-known example of a 'periodic table' / ranked-tile asset-class return chart. Useful here as the reference design for a ranked annual asset-class returns chart, not as a data feed.

notes: Every automated fetch attempt against callan.com (the periodic-table landing page, the year-specific research page, and the policies-disclosures page identified by search) returned HTTP 403 from what the response identified as Cloudflare's 'Attention Required' challenge page, for both the WebFetch tool and a browser-UA curl request. This blocks automated access; it is not evidence the pages don't exist or carry no terms — a terms page was located by search (see terms.url) but its content is understood only from search-result summaries, not from a directly read page, so no read_from is claimed on this block.
